_comment_toolToggles: Optional per-tool enable/disable. When 'enabledTools' is a non-empty array, ONLY those tools are exposed (allowlist). Otherwise, any tool listed in 'disabledTools' is hidden (denylist). enabledTools takes precedence. Env overrides: COLLIBRA_ENABLED_TOOLS / COLLIBRA_DISABLED_TOOLS (comma-separated).
